brand.name: Pulsewatch
brand.tagline: Monitor your apps' uptime with confidence.

sections.copy: Top bar with logo and user avatar. Sidebar with 'Settings' tab highlighted.
Card with label 'Profile', text input for name, email, and password. Helper text: 'Password must be at least 8 characters'. Toggle for 'Enable 2FA'.
Card with label 'Notifications', segmented control for 'Email', 'Push', and 'SMS'. Radio rows for 'Critical alerts only' and 'All alerts'.

sections.purpose: Form section for billing and subscription
sections.copy: Card with label 'Billing', select for 'Subscription plan', and a toggle for 'Auto-renew'. Helper text: 'Your current plan ends on 2025-05-01'.
Card with label 'Delete Account', warning text: 'This action is irreversible. All data will be permanently deleted.', and a danger button labeled 'Delete Account'.

sections.purpose: Footer with save and cancel actions
sections.copy: Inline actions with primary button 'Save Changes' and secondary button 'Cancel'.

palette_hint: White/`#f6f8fb` surfaces, slate ink `#0f172a`, muted `#5b6b82`, professional blue `#2563eb` for primary actions; soft `#e6ebf2` borders.
type_hint: System sans-serif, medium weights, clear hierarchy, readable and even.
